notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
- upgraded game to Unreal Engine verion 4.23
- added always run option
- now invert y axis option works for both gamepad and mouse
- added hint how to exit the forklift
- changed gamepad mapping for kick, jump and undo
- now you cannot leave the car while in customization menu
- now bunny colors are saved asynchronously which prevents freezes after kicking Bunny Paint board
- now you can use (b) button on gamepad to back from the menu
- fixed that sliders decreased in size when hovering
- fixed that you couldn't use Esc button in solo mode to exit the menus
- in solo mode if steam overlay is opened the game will be paused
- other minor improvements

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.content:
It shouldn't be # 1 but it seems we forget to post the previous really small patches.
So let this be the first one.

- fixed that you can zoom camera in the menu
- fixed training achievement (I hope)
- fixed that some levels achievements trigger after completing the next level but not the one you've completed

P.S.: now if you meet the conditions the missing achievements should trigger after entering the game level
P.S.: fixed maxi 37 level where on the box spawn in the wrong place (thanks to @Jellinator)
